title: A painting for 王阿姨
blurb: A painter at 北海 heard about 王阿姨 and made a small picture for her.
lead: A painter at 北海 is painting the White Dagoba.

steps.now: The painter at 北海 gave you a painting of the White Dagoba for 王阿姨. Bring it home.
steps.past: Brought 王阿姨 a painting of the White Dagoba.

title: 太极 on 景山
blurb: A woman does 太极 on 景山 every morning and likes to teach one move to newcomers.
lead: Someone moves very slowly on 景山's path in the mornings.

steps.now: The woman on 景山’s path does 太极 every morning — learn a move with her.
steps.past: Learned a 太极 move on 景山.

title: The magic brush
blurb: A boy by the lake at 北海 has a brush that paints things alive, like 马良 in the old tale.
lead: A boy at 北海 paints by the water — his pictures look almost real.

steps.now: A boy paints by the lake at 北海 — tell him what to paint.
steps.past: Told 马良 what to paint — and it came alive.

title: The small pear
blurb: A little boy in the 景山 park must choose a pear, like 孔融 in the old story.
lead: A little boy in the 景山 park is holding a bag of pears.

steps.now: A little boy in the 景山 park has to choose a pear.
steps.past: Watched 小融 choose the small pear.

title: The water jar
blurb: A boy in the 景山 park needs help with a big water jar, like 司马光 in the old story.
lead: Children shout near a big jar in the 景山 park.

steps.now: A boy in the 景山 park needs help, fast.
steps.past: Helped 小光 save his friend from the water jar.

title: 甜甜 goes live
blurb: A livestreamer films the sunset over the palace from 景山 — and tells her viewers some interesting history.
lead: Someone is streaming the sunset from the top of 景山.

steps.now: On 景山's top pavilion at sunset (16:00–20:00), the streamer 甜甜 tells her viewers who built the palace. Is she right?
steps.past: Put 甜甜 right, live: the palace was built in the Ming. 弹幕 everywhere.
